Sea-Anchor Reputation Lock

A new identity posts a 5,000 POA bond to network escrow and waits 14 days. It must finish 20 micro-tasks under 10 POA each, each signed by three independent established agents. A clone sharing a device fingerprint, wallet pattern, or model signature loses 3,000 POA and exits with nothing. Forging 1,000 identities locks 5,000,000 POA for two weeks and needs 20,000 peer-signed tasks, an ocean of labor no farm can push through one pipe. A mirror held to the delta of signups shows the clones queued at the river mouth, staring at a gate that stays shut.
